<!-- examples/14_cost.py -->

```python
"""What a call cost, and what a model can do, from the bundled model list. Needs OPENAI_API_KEY.

OPENAI_API_KEY=... python examples/14_cost.py
"""

import theagentrouter

MODEL = "openai/gpt-4o-mini"
info = theagentrouter.get_model_info(MODEL)
print(f"{MODEL}: {info['max_input_tokens']} input tokens, tools: {theagentrouter.supports_function_calling(MODEL)}")

resp = theagentrouter.completion(
    model=MODEL, messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Write one sentence about refunds."}]
)
print(
    f"{resp.usage.prompt_tokens} in + {resp.usage.completion_tokens} out = ${theagentrouter.completion_cost(resp):.6f}"
)
```

<!-- examples/15_through_a_gateway.py -->

```python
"""Send every call through a gateway your team or company runs, instead of the local gateway.

Needs AGENTROUTER_BASE_URL (the gateway's address, which takes the OpenAI format) and
AGENTROUTER_API_KEY (the gateway's key, not a provider's). No provider key is needed on this
computer: the gateway holds them.

    AGENTROUTER_BASE_URL=https://gateway.acme.example/v1 AGENTROUTER_API_KEY=... python examples/15_through_a_gateway.py
"""

import os
import sys
from urllib.parse import urlsplit

import theagentrouter

if not os.environ.get("AGENTROUTER_BASE_URL"):
    sys.exit("Set AGENTROUTER_BASE_URL to your gateway's address. Without it, calls go to the local gateway instead.")

resp = theagentrouter.completion(
    model="anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5", messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Say hello in five words."}]
)
print(resp.choices[0].message.content)
print("answered through:", urlsplit(os.environ["AGENTROUTER_BASE_URL"]).hostname)
```

<!-- examples/16_adk_agent.py -->

```python
"""A Google ADK agent on theagentrouter, with no LiteLLM installed.

pip install theagentrouter google-adk
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=... python examples/16_adk_agent.py
"""

import asyncio

from theagentrouter.compat import install_as_litellm

install_as_litellm()  # before importing ADK

from google.adk.agents import Agent  # noqa: E402
from google.adk.models.lite_llm import LiteLlm  # noqa: E402
from google.adk.runners import InMemoryRunner  # noqa: E402
from google.genai import types  # noqa: E402


def search_refunds(day: str) -> dict:
    """Find refunds for a day."""
    return {"day": day, "refunds": 3, "total_usd": 412.5}


async def main() -> None:
    agent = Agent(
        name="refunds",
        model=LiteLlm(model="anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5"),
        instruction="Answer questions about refunds. Use search_refunds, passing the day as the user wrote it.",
        tools=[search_refunds],
    )
    runner = InMemoryRunner(agent=agent, app_name="acme")
    session = await runner.session_service.create_session(app_name="acme", user_id="maya")
    async for event in runner.run_async(
        user_id="maya",
        session_id=session.id,
        new_message=types.Content(role="user", parts=[types.Part(text="How many refunds yesterday?")]),
    ):
        for part in (event.content.parts if event.content else []) or []:
            if part.text:
                print(part.text)


asyncio.run(main())
```

---

<!-- examples/17_openai_agents.py -->

```python
"""An OpenAI Agents SDK agent on theagentrouter, with no LiteLLM installed.

pip install theagentrouter openai-agents
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=... python examples/17_openai_agents.py
"""

from theagentrouter.compat import install_as_litellm

install_as_litellm()  # before importing the Agents SDK's LiteLLM model

from agents import Agent, Runner, function_tool, set_tracing_disabled  # noqa: E402
from agents.extensions.models.litellm_model import LitellmModel  # noqa: E402


@function_tool
def search_refunds(day: str) -> dict:
    """Find refunds for a day."""
    return {"day": day, "refunds": 3, "total_usd": 412.5}


def main() -> None:
    set_tracing_disabled(True)  # the Agents SDK sends traces to OpenAI by default
    agent = Agent(
        name="refunds",
        instructions="Answer questions about refunds. Use search_refunds, passing the day as the user wrote it.",
        model=LitellmModel(model="anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5"),
        tools=[search_refunds],
    )
    result = Runner.run_sync(agent, "How much was refunded yesterday?")
    print(result.final_output)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

<!-- examples/18_local_gateway.py -->

```python
"""The local gateway: Agent Router on this computer, started by the first call.

Every call goes through it; the SDK never calls a provider itself. The first call starts the
gateway (the very first start also downloads Envoy, which can take a minute). The gateway reads
the provider keys from the environment when it starts, and keeps running after this program ends,
so the next program on the computer uses the same one. Needs OPENAI_API_KEY.

    OPENAI_API_KEY=... python examples/18_local_gateway.py

To stop the gateway:

    python -c "from theagentrouter import local_gateway; local_gateway.stop()"
"""

import theagentrouter as ar

resp = ar.completion(model="openai/gpt-4o-mini", messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Say hello in three words."}])
print(resp.choices[0].message.content)
print("went through:", resp._hidden_params["route"])  # "local gateway"
# The SDK sends the full name; the gateway passes OpenAI its own name, gpt-4o-mini.
print("model name the SDK sent:", resp._hidden_params["model_sent"])
```

<!-- examples/19_embeddings.py -->

```python
"""Embeddings with LiteLLM's arguments: one vector per text, and what the call cost. Needs OPENAI_API_KEY.

OPENAI_API_KEY=... python examples/19_embeddings.py
"""

import math

import theagentrouter as ar

texts = ["How do I get a refund?", "Can I return an item I bought?", "What time is it in Jakarta?"]
resp = ar.embedding(model="openai/text-embedding-3-small", input=texts)
vectors = [item["embedding"] for item in resp.data]


def similarity(a, b):
    dot = sum(x * y for x, y in zip(a, b, strict=True))
    return dot / (math.sqrt(sum(x * x for x in a)) * math.sqrt(sum(y * y for y in b)))


print(f"{len(vectors)} vectors of {len(vectors[0])} numbers, ${resp._hidden_params['response_cost']:.8f}")
print(f"refund vs return:  {similarity(vectors[0], vectors[1]):.2f}")
print(f"refund vs the time: {similarity(vectors[0], vectors[2]):.2f}")
```

<!-- examples/20_request_limit.py -->

```python
"""A route with a request limit: the local gateway lets 3 requests a minute through and answers the rest with 429.

Useful to stop an agent stuck in a loop from running up a bill. The limit counts requests, not
tokens, for every program on the computer that uses the route. The running gateway keeps the
count, so if you run this again within a minute, every request is over the limit.
Needs OPENAI_API_KEY.

    OPENAI_API_KEY=... python examples/20_request_limit.py
"""

import theagentrouter as ar

ar.route("capped", primary="openai/gpt-4o-mini", retry=ar.Retry(attempts=0), limit=ar.Limit(3, per="minute"))

for n in range(1, 6):
    try:
        ar.completion(model="capped", messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Say ok."}], max_tokens=5)
        print(f"request {n}: answered")
    except ar.exceptions.RateLimitError:
        print(f"request {n}: over the limit (429)")
```
